title: 第21章 云家密话第22章 云国小会
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
待得七位师兄弟纷纷告辞，云岫烟漫步来到隔壁院落。
一中年男子站在石拱桥上，身姿挺拔，芝兰玉树，手里捻着几粒灵米，不时洒下，引得几尾灵鱼争相抢食，水面一片欢腾。
听到脚步声，中年男子没有回头，专心的喂着灵鱼。
直到云岫烟走到身后，中年男子才将手掌侧过来，另一只手抹了抹，将灵米全部拍落，这才回过头来。
云岫烟盯着中年男子，脸上的寒冰似乎消散了许多，轻声道：“三叔可有决定？”
这人正是云岫烟三叔，之前送过灵玉果树，让过灵泉眼，对云岫烟很是疼爱。
同时，他也是云家唯一一位筑基真修——云飞澜。
云飞澜微微颔首，淡淡说道：“那个顾安和黄轩还不错，值得投资。”
云岫烟杏眼中闪过疑惑，有些不明白，云飞澜出声解释道：“顾安年纪轻轻，已是炼气五层，天资在三灵根中也算上等，不必多说。”
“黄轩做事处世圆滑，做事稳当，思虑周全，也很不错。”
云岫烟也是钟灵毓秀之人，云飞澜一解释，就明白过来为什么这两人合适，点了点头，“岫烟明白了，会让人调查这两人情况的。”
至于谭乘风，两人谁都没有提，炼气九层，唬唬别人还行，以他两人的眼界，怎会看不出谭乘风一身灵力虚浮无比，丹毒入髓，前路已断。
抿了抿嘴唇，云岫烟有些欲言又止。
云飞澜看她犹豫不决，知道她在想什么，摇了摇手说道，“不必担心，我还能撑个十来年，届时你已筑基，我云家自可高枕无忧，现在只是未雨绸缪罢了。”
“不过岫烟你毕竟是青元宗的弟子，我云家还是需要一位坐镇云城的筑基真修才方便。”
“筑基丹的灵药你也多注意点，我这边也会时刻……”
说着，云飞澜突然用锦帕捂住嘴，连声咳嗽，锦帕上竟渗出一丝血迹。
“难道就没什么治愈的办法吗？我去求师傅！”云岫烟担心的看着，银牙紧咬。
“千万不要，我使用禁术，寿元大减，难的不是伤势，是寿元！”云飞澜厉声打断，凝声道，“岫烟你记住，青霄真人是你师傅，但没有义务每次都帮你，上次你执意要送晚溪进宗已是消耗情分，现在又何必做那徒劳无功之事。”
云岫烟眼眶微红，可她性子冰冷，终究没有再说什么。

见她情绪不佳，云飞澜也很无奈，只得转移话题道：“对了，刚刚答应你的青翅鸟，你回宗交给晚溪吧。”
“我还有两年的任务没做完呢，你让别人去给吧。”云岫烟眉头微蹙，拒绝道。
“诶！你怎么这么固执呢？”虽然是责怪的话，但云飞澜的语气里却带有几分宠溺。
但话锋一转，语气坚定，“不过这次你真得回去。”
云岫烟更加疑惑的问道：“三叔，为什么，可有什么不妥？”
长叹了一口气后，云飞澜凝重的说道：“青元宗的王扬前几天来黄风郡调查劫修之事，追到了御兽宗的范围内，堂而皇之的杀了人家的弟子，扬长而去。”
“御兽宗不可能忍气吞声，必有报复，这也是我不让你买那白玉狐的原因。”
“接下来几年，云国和幽国势必变的混乱。”
云岫烟听了这话，也反应过来，“两宗大战？”
云飞澜摇了摇头，眼睛盯着下面灵鱼争食，感叹道：“还没那么严重，但事态如何发展却不好说。”
“青元宗和御兽宗离的太近了！”
天下熙熙，皆为利来，天下攘攘，皆为利往。
content_en:
After the seven fellow apprentices all left, Yun Xiuyan strolled to the courtyard next door.
A middle-aged man stood on the stone arch bridge, with a tall and straight posture, like orchids and jade trees. He twisted a few grains of spiritual rice in his hand, and sprinkled it from time to time, attracting several spiritual fish to compete for food, and the water surface was filled with joy.
Hearing the footsteps, the middle-aged man did not look back and concentrated on feeding the spirit fish.
It wasn't until Yun Xiuyan came behind him that the middle-aged man turned his palm over, wiped it with his other hand, and patted all the spiritual rice off, and then turned around.
Yun Xiuyan stared at the middle-aged man, the ice on her face seemed to have dissipated a lot, and said softly: "Does Third Uncle have a decision?"
This person was none other than Yun Xiuyan's third uncle. He had given away spiritual jade fruit trees and spiritual springs before, and he loved Yun Xiuyan very much.
At the same time, he is also the only foundation-building true cultivator in the Yun family - Yun Feilan.
Yun Feilan nodded slightly and said calmly: "Gu An and Huang Xuan are not bad and worth investing in."
Doubts flashed in Yunxiu Yanxing's eyes, and she was a little confused. Yun Feilan explained aloud: "Gu An is young and is already at the fifth level of Qi Refining. His talent is considered to be among the highest among the three spiritual roots. There is no need to say more."
"Huang Xuan is smooth, prudent and considerate. He is also very good."
Yun Xiuyan is also a handsome person. As soon as Yun Feilan explained, he understood why these two people were suitable and nodded, "Xiuyan understands and will let people investigate the situation of these two people."
As for Tan Chengfeng, neither of them mentioned that it was okay to bluff others at the ninth level of Qi Refining. With their eyesight, how could they not see that Tan Chengfeng's spiritual power was extremely vain, erysipelas had entered his marrow, and his future was blocked.
Pursing her lips, Yun Xiuyan hesitated to speak.
Seeing her hesitation, Yun Feilan knew what she was thinking, so she shook her hand and said, "Don't worry, I can still hold on for more than ten years. By then you will have established the foundation, and my Yun family can rest easy. Now we are just preparing for a rainy day."
"But Xiuyan, you are a disciple of Qingyuan Sect after all. Our Yun family still needs a foundation-building true cultivator who is in charge of Yun City."
"You should also pay more attention to the elixir of the Foundation Establishment Pill. I will also be here at all times..."
As he spoke, Yun Feilan suddenly covered his mouth with a brocade handkerchief and coughed repeatedly. A trace of blood oozed from the brocade handkerchief.
"Is there no cure? I'll ask the master!" Yun Xiuyan looked worriedly, gritting her teeth.
"Don't do it. I used the forbidden technique and my lifespan was greatly reduced. The problem is not the injury, but my lifespan!" Yun Feilan interrupted sharply and said in a condensed voice, "Xiuyan, remember, Master Qingxiao is your master, but he has no obligation to help you every time. Last time you insisted on sending Wanxi to join the sect, which was a waste of love, so why do you have to do that futile thing now."
Yun Xiuyan's eyes were slightly red, but her temper was cold and she didn't say anything else.
Seeing that she was in a bad mood, Yun Feilan was helpless, so she had to change the subject and said: "By the way, the Blue-winged Bird who just promised you, you can return to the sect and give it to Wan Xi."
"I still have two years of unfinished tasks. You can let others do it." Yun Xiuyan frowned slightly and refused.
"Hey! Why are you so stubborn?" Although the words were meant to blame, Yun Feilan's tone was somewhat doting.
But the conversation changed and his tone was firm, "But you really have to go back this time."
Yun Xiuyan asked even more doubtfully: "Third uncle, why, is there anything wrong?"
After letting out a long sigh, Yun Feilan said solemnly: "Wang Yang from the Qingyuan Sect came to Huangfeng County a few days ago to investigate the robbery incident. He chased him to the area of the Beast Control Sect, openly killed his disciples, and walked away."
"The Beast Control Sect cannot swallow its anger, there will be revenge. This is why I won't let you buy the white jade fox."
"In the next few years, the Yun Kingdom and the You Kingdom are bound to become chaotic."
After hearing this, Yun Xiuyan reacted, "A battle between two sects?"
Yun Feilan shook his head, staring at the spirit fish fighting for food below, and sighed: "It's not that serious, but it's hard to say how the situation will develop."
"greenYuan Zong and Yu Beast Sect are too close! "
The bustle in the world is all for the benefit of coming, and the hustle and bustle of the world is all for the benefit of the going.
